sample_unit: patient FAQs (each answered by 3 LLMs, rated by 14 experts)

links.outcome: Readability (FRE, FKG) of LLM responses to oral lichen planus patient FAQs
links.effect: Most responses required college-level literacy; ChatGPT produced the most complex texts, Gemini occasionally more accessible, Copilot intermediate.
links.quote: Readability analysis revealed that most responses required college-level literacy, with ChatGPT producing the most complex texts, Gemini occasionally achieving more accessible outputs, and Copilot situated in an intermediate position.

links.outcome: Reference provision in LLM responses to patient FAQs
links.effect: Reference provision was inconsistent across all chatbots.
links.quote: The reference provision was inconsistent across all chatbots.

screen.reason: Evaluates the accuracy, quality, and readability of three commercial LLMs responding to oral lichen planus FAQs without testing specific organizational deployment safeguards or practices.
